name: Technical Content Marketing & Technical SEO
description: Creating high-impact technical blog posts, architectural case studies, whitepapers, thought leadership, developer evangelism content, and optimizing technical documentation for search engines (SEO).

subskills.name: Technical Blog Post Authoring & Storytelling
subskills.description: Writing engaging technical blog posts that break down complex engineering concepts, benchmark comparisons, and architectural deep-dives.

subskills.name: Doc Metadata, Open Graph & Structured Data
subskills.description: Structuring doc metadata, title tags, meta descriptions, Open Graph tags, canonical URLs, semantic HTML tags, and schema.org markup for technical docs.

subskills.name: Technical Keyword Research & Search Intent
subskills.description: Conducting technical keyword research, search intent mapping (informational, navigational, transactional), and identifying high-volume developer queries.

subskills.name: Technical Whitepapers & In-Depth Ebooks
subskills.description: Authoring in-depth technical whitepapers, architectural blueprints, enterprise ebooks, and solution briefs for technical decision-makers.

subskills.name: Customer Case Studies & Migration Stories
subskills.description: Interviewing enterprise engineering teams and authoring technical customer success stories, migration case studies, and ROI breakdowns.

subskills.name: Developer Advocacy & Community Content
subskills.description: Authoring community tutorials, Reddit/Hacker News technical announcements, newsletter issues, and open-source contribution guides.

subskills.name: Technical SEO Architecture & Crawlability
subskills.description: Architecting docs site SEO: crawl budget optimization, sitemap generation, structured data, indexation strategy, and resolving duplicate content.

subskills.name: Organic Traffic Analytics & Conversion Tracking
subskills.description: Analyzing organic search traffic growth, keyword rankings, bounce rate on docs, time-on-page, and doc-to-signup conversion attribution.

subskills.name: Thought Leadership & Industry Benchmark Reports
subskills.description: Writing authoritative industry benchmark reports, state-of-the-industry reports, trend analyses, and keynote scripts for executive engineers.
